plan: an account with billing set up
limits: One model that generates runs on this account: lightricks/ltx-2.5-fast, at 720p (its lowest resolution), one clip of 2 to 20 seconds per prediction. Models that generate nothing (they only read a frame from, cut, crop, resize, join or convert files you already have) also run: they are community models, run through create_predictions with the version given as owner/name:version. Create each prediction without the Prefer option, then read it with get_predictions until it finishes. The account has credit for 6 seconds of generated video in total.
